extName.message: Dark Reverse Thread – Gmail dark mode & newest-first

extDescription.description: Extension description shown in Chrome and the Web Store (max 132 characters).

popupSubtitle.description: Subtitle under the extension name in the popup.

settingDarkDesc.description: Popup setting description for dark mode.

settingReply.description: Popup setting label: where the reply box is placed.

replyNeedsReverse.message: Available when Reverse Thread Order is on

quickDark.description: Quick bar button: dark mode toggle (followed by ON/OFF). Keep short.
